meta.rules: Fixed-alpha L(1/3) history only. Quasi-polynomial algorithms live in other categories. Here L_X[α,c] = exp((c+o(1))(ln X)^α(ln ln X)^(1−α)); all logarithms in this definition are natural. Only compare entries with this cost scale, input domain and computational model. Polynomial and quasi-polynomial expressions without an extracted scalar are not ranked.
